items.evidence: Loop aspirates/dispenses 40 uL beads per well, p300.mix(10, 70, well), then comment and delay(minutes=5) before the magnet comment.
Magnet engage comment plus 5 min delay, then 90 uL removed from each of 96 wells to waste, then two 200 uL ethanol add/remove cycles per well; all checks passed.
5 min delay for air dry, disengage comment, 50 uL water with mix(10, 40), 2 min delay, then re-engage comment and 5 min delay.
zip(sample_wells, elution_wells) moves 45 uL from each sample well to matching elution well; end_state:elution_plate passed.
pick_up() and drop_tip() per well in every step; no_cross_contamination check passed.

judge.summary: The protocol follows all 13 steps with correct volumes, 10x mixes, and delays/comments for the non-simulated steps. It uses a fresh tip per well and preserves sample identity into the elution plate, and all measured checks passed.
